edits.before: We explored letting the model draw free-form UI and restricting it to each system's published React components. Free-form looked impressive and was unusable. Official-only won. The output is something a developer recognises, at the cost of the model having fewer moves.
edits.after: I use defined canvas blocks with native component mappings where available and explicit fallbacks where a system has no equivalent. The output is something a developer can inspect.
